note: Independent rejudgment 2026-11-24 against RFC 8654 Section 5 (rfc/full/rfc8654.txt): "A BGP speaker that has the ability to use BGP Extended Messages but has not advertised the BGP Extended Message Capability, presumably due to configuration, MUST NOT accept a BGP Extended Message." Verified the sole change since 12ae330a4b (34227d6869): capability.Negotiate added `case *FQDN: neg.PeerFQDN = sanitizeFQDN(cap)`, which touches neither ExtendedMessageRecv nor ExtendedMessageSend. All other four producers (prepareNegotiation, publishNegotiation, readFrame, readAndProcessCoalesced) and all six tagged test entries (TestValidateLengthWithMax #1/#2, TestRFC8654ReceiveLimitFollowsLocalOPEN #1/#2, checkExtendedNeitherRejectFRR, checkExtendedRemoteOnlyRejectFRR) are byte-identical and enforce exact 4096/4097/65535 limits and NOTIFICATION 1/2 based strictly on local capability 6 advertisement. Verdict stands: enforced.
